patch_list: Block Pre-Roll Video Ads & Interstitials - FCTV33 & RBTV+
Completely strips pre-roll video ads, loading countdown shades, direct link popups, and banner ads before live stream playback on FCTV33 & RBTV+ (Mobile & TV).
Enables Picture-in-Picture (PiP) mode across all streams, activates portrait PiP controls, adds background PiP support, and stabilizes fullscreen orientation switching on FCTV33 & RBTV+.
Unlock Permanent VIP & Activation - FCTV33 & RBTV+
Bypasses activation lock codes, unlocks free VIP status, and lifts channel access restrictions on FCTV33 & RBTV+.
